title: Protocol-aware safety parity models
summary: Parity stimulus/checking and read-channel sideband integration for a lightweight non-coherent interconnect testbench.

dates.note: Null boundaries preserve unknown project/rotation dates. Inspected author/committer milestones are identified in evidence; they are not employment, project-start, shipment or acceptance dates.

facts.text: Created strobe-aware odd-parity generation and validity-gated checking models, connecting write-data safety codes and error observation into an interconnect testbench.
Extended safety testbench protection to read request/response paths and authored parameterized AXI/AHB read-data parity generators and checkers with response-sideband offsets.
Modeled byte-level read parity with a parity bit and marker per eight data bits at the inspected setting, and configured VIP invalid read lanes to drive random binary values rather than Xs.

Existing write request/response support was colleague-authored. Michael’s read extension was reverted and reapplied as the same patch, then protected-address slicing and later protocol coverage evolved; these are not separate feature deliveries or proof of universal address protection.
These are historical testbench-side safety models. They do not establish delivered DUT datapath parity logic, current top-level use, functional-safety certification or measured detection coverage.
